category_edits.rationale: Test whether increasing residual scale from 0.5 to 0.65 improves contextual modeling across all four datasets. Preserve causal convolutions and all other model and training settings; synchronize checkpoint metadata and predictor compatibility checks.

response.change_summary: Increase every NextItNet block’s residual scale to 0.65 and update metadata and the embedded predictor check, retaining one independently trained checkpoint per dataset.
